quotations.old_english: Sécen hié him broc on onráde and on wǽne
quotations.english: let them seek for themselves fatigue in riding on horseback and in a carriage

source_text: on-rád, e; f. Riding on horseback:--Sécen hié him broc on onráde and on wǽne let them seek for themselves fatigue in riding on horseback and in a carriage, Lchdm. ii. 184, 13.
